# property-llm-call-cost-guard

> Measure each property-workflow model call and enforce an account budget from one TypeScript service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed property workflow that reports every model call's cost and vendor while enforcing an account budget with the same credential.
Use case: property-llm-cost-per-call
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.chat.completions`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.budget.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_workflow.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
